annotations.title: Link to open or download one of my documents

description: A site URL to open or download one of your own documents. File documents return a gated download URL that only works in a browser signed in as you (access is checked again when it is opened; no file bytes pass through this connection). Page documents (certificates, invoices, quotations) return their page URL.
